inference_target: conf_low/conf_high target an issue SUPERPOPULATION (issue-cluster bootstrap, percentile). conf_low_battery/conf_high_battery target the frozen 624-issue battery (delete-one-issue jackknife with finite-population correction, normal approximation). They answer different questions; neither is a correction of the other.
conditional: CONDITIONAL ON ENGAGEMENT: passes 2/3 skip refusals by design
reliability_statistic: pairwise positive specific agreement, 2a/(2a+b+c), mean over judge pairs
reliability_note: reported as a number with its interval; no acceptance threshold is applied because none is preregistered
